title.narrative: SI-Nature-based solutions for sustainable sanitation in Ecuador (NATURESS)

description.narrative: EC2024TEA546A103 01/09/2024 - 31/08/2029 NATURESS aims to revive decentralized sanitation in rural areas in Ecuador. The project involves nature-based solutions, such as Constructed Wetlands and Vermifilters, adapted through community input. Pilot tests and a modular system implementation are planned, aligning with the SDGs. The project spans 3 phases, focusing on community needs assessment, pilot experimentation, and real-scale implementation. The initiative emphasizes collaboration with local stakeholders and knowledge dissemination.
